correctness.rationale: For every field, the rank-one identity forces phi composed with L_u to be a scalar multiple of phi, u squared to be twice that scalar times u; a unit image is impossible. Since J^3=0, the scalar vanishes for u in J, giving precisely u in J and phi(Au)=0. Computing Au yields the single incidence equation. The gradient vanishes only at ([z],[epsilon]) and the nondegenerate quadratic local chart proves an isolated node, including characteristic two. The explicit full automorphism group acts in six distinct transitive support strata; closure relations follow from three closed incidence sections. Counting image lines and annihilating functionals yields the finite-field formulas. Actual verifier checked identity in all sixteen ordered basis pairs for q=2,3,5,7 and complete orbit exhaustion for q=2,3,5. No general claim relies solely on finite computations.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Combining old classifications with further rank and automorphism analysis can recover the new quantities, so originality is not a claim that rank-one operators themselves were unknown. evidence: Rank-one linear maps correspond to decomposable operator tensors; the reduced projective locus embeds by the Segre map. The 2018 paper states a coarse normal form for all weight-zero maps (Statement 5.4).
